data.exact_reserve_text: The movements in 2016 have been affected by the change in the Ogden discount rate from 2.5% to minus 0.75% causing deteriorations in the gross position. The net impact to the syndicate is reduced due to the benefit of reinsurance.

named_events.event_name: Revision of Ogden discount rate from 2.5% to minus 0.75%
named_events.impact_description: Change in Ogden discount rate caused a deterioration in gross claims outstanding of GBP 155.750m, partially offset by reinsurers' share of GBP 122.281m leading to a net adverse impact of GBP 33.469m to the syndicate's result.

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims reserves at 1 January 2016 were GBP 570.85m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net adverse prior-year development (strengthening) of approximately GBP 54.69m (c.9.6% of opening reserves), driven materially by changes in long-tail injury valuation assumptions, principally the Ogden discount rate revision, with the net P&L impact reduced by reinsurance recoveries. Movements were concentrated in older motor years (2011-2014).
raw_causal_phrases: The movements in 2016 have been affected by the change in the Ogden discount rate from 2.5% to minus 0.75% causing deteriorations in the gross position.
The net impact to the syndicate is reduced due to the benefit of reinsurance.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year movement (gross) was computed from the gross claims development triangle (page 27). The Movement in prior year provision note reports net figures (total net release GBP 11.506k) - triangle-based gross movement (+GBP 54.693m) differs because it is gross of reinsurance and the report identifies a large subsequent Ogden-driven increase in gross reserves that is partly offset by reinsurance. RITC and discount-rate revisions have distorted movements; use triangle-derived gross figure as primary gross PYD source.
